title: Umoya Othembekileyo WeSityhilelo
intro: Kwiindawo ezingabonakaliyo, isidalwa esinokukhanya okumsulwa sihamba ngokuchanekileyo, senza yonke imiyalelo ngaphandle kokuthandabuza. Esi sidalwa sithethe nezinceku ezikhethiweyo, sizise amazwi esikhokelo, saza sabona ukutyhilwa kwemimiselo kaThixo kuzo zonke izizukulwana. Ngubani lo mphefumlo uhloniphekileyo?
clues: Ndingumntu onokukhanya okumsulwa, odalwe ngokukhanya, kwaye andikaze ndiwuthobele umyalelo weNkosi yam.
Ndihamba phakathi kwamazulu nomhlaba, ndihla nemimiselo yoMnininceba.
Ndathunyelwa kwintombi ehloniphekileyo engcweleni, ndayixelela ngonyana omsulwa.
Ndingumoya wobungcwele, kwaye ndixhase umprofeti owayenikwe imiqondiso ecacileyo kunye neVangeli.
Ndifike emqolombeni entabeni ukuze ndithethe amazwi okuqala engoma eyayiza kugcinwa ngonaphakade.
Ndingumoya othembekileyo, kwaye ndim owayithoba intliziyo yomthunywa wokugqibela iQuran.

outcome.label: Isiphumo soMsebenzi
options: Isihogo sasilindwe kwaye amasango aso ayevaliwe
